info.title: BrainSNN World Projects API
info.description: Private operator-provisioned API for durable tenant projects, source evidence, revisions, review decisions, trial outcomes, and an optional owner-scoped processing bridge. PostgreSQL and explicit worker configuration are required. This contract does not assert field validation or provide public signup/billing. Processing success payloads preserve native extensible worker objects; discover engines through capabilities. Optional private S3-compatible chunk storage retains large original sources through resumable uploads. Project export schema v2 includes inline bytes and authenticated external-source references; it is not a self-contained media archive.

post.summary: Verify and retain the completed original
post.description: Streams all stored parts and checks the complete SHA-256 before adding a source and incrementing project version. A late stale-version 409 leaves the transfer ready: reload the project and explicitly complete with a new key/version, without uploading parts again. Verification uses a five-minute recovery lease. After an ambiguous timeout, inspect transfer/project state and reuse the original request/key; do not create another source automatically. Full verification has a server deadline just under five minutes; the SDK permits a five-minute deadline for this operation only.

get.summary: Stream authenticated exact retained source bytes
get.description: Works for inline and object sources. Requires a project key in Authorization; never redirects to an object-store URL. No Range support. Checks each chunk and the whole-file digest, withholding the last chunk until verification passes. A mid-stream error terminates the body; consumers must verify exact length/hash and commit their destination only after success. Downloads have a one-hour overall server deadline and a 30-second stalled-client-write timeout. Each fresh download reserves its declared full length against the tenant hourly source-read allowance.

ProjectApiKey.description: Named, scoped, expiring key; raw tokens are never stored in project records.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable for exactly one intended mutation. Replay returns the original compact action receipt and applied_version with the current project aggregate. A different body/path with this key returns 409. Keys are scoped by tenant and actor.

ClientRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
ClientRequestId.description: Client correlation only; server assigns and returns its own X-Request-Id.

processing_ticket.name: ticket
processing_ticket.description: Short-lived owner-bound ticket. A project Authorization header is still required.

ProcessingIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ProcessingIdempotencyKey.description: Persisted natively by the worker for seven days for create-upload, create-job and start-job. Reuse unchanged body/key after a lost response; no automatic rerun. A deleted replayed resource returns 410.

ProcessingOffset.name: offset
ProcessingOffset.description: Exact accepted byte offset from GET upload status. Read status after a lost PUT response before explicitly resuming.

SourcePartSha256.name: X-Content-SHA256
SourcePartSha256.description: SHA-256 of these exact part bytes. The server independently recomputes the digest.

SourcePartLength.name: Content-Length
SourcePartLength.description: Exact part byte count: upload.part_bytes except the final remainder. Fetch supplies this header for a Uint8Array or Blob body; browser callers must not set it manually.

sourceReadBytesPerHour.description: Declared source bytes reserved for downloads and fresh full verification per tenant per hour; default 8 GiB. Failed/aborted transfers also consume their reservation.

configured.description: Configuration present, not an active provider health check. A successful transfer establishes availability.

configuration_invalid.description: Present when supplied object-storage configuration is invalid; no provider health claim.

download_path.description: Same-origin authenticated API path. Never a public or signed object-store URL.

content_text.description: Exact UTF-8 bytes are retained. Decoded payload must be 1–524288 bytes; character count is not byte count.

data_base64.description: Canonical standard base64 for 1–524288 decoded bytes.

sha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256 of exact decoded source bytes.

data_base64.description: Exact bytes for inline sources; null for object sources. Stream object bytes from the authenticated content route.

download_path.description: Same-origin authenticated API path. Never a public or signed object-store URL.

parent_revision_id.description: Required for a proposed revision; must name an existing as-is revision. Change proposals require the current as-is baseline.

robot_model.description: Must equal the robot model on the immutable revision.

task.description: Must exactly equal revision.task.goal. Use a new revision for a different task.

occurred_at.description: ISO timestamp at most five minutes in the future.

source_bytes.description: Retained inline source bytes. Object source and reservation bytes are separate counters.

source_read_bytes_this_hour.description: Conservative declared-byte reservations, not measured network egress or billing.

token.description: Returned only on the first successful response. Never persisted as plaintext in the request ledger.

Readiness.description: Record completeness using the latest physical outcome by occurred_at and then recorded project version. A historical pass does not hide a later fail/inconclusive result. No physical certification is implied.

parent_revision_id.description: Required for a proposed revision; must name an existing as-is revision. Change proposals require the current as-is baseline.

robot_model.description: Must equal the robot model on the immutable revision.

task.description: Must exactly equal revision.task.goal. Use a new revision for a different task.

occurred_at.description: ISO timestamp at most five minutes in the future.

applied_version.description: Version created by this action; may be older than project.version on a replay.

includes_all_source_bytes.description: False whenever an object source is referenced. Download and verify each external source separately for a complete media archive.

ProjectExport.description: Version 2 project manifest with inline source bytes and authenticated references for object sources. The unsigned canonical hash covers this JSON manifest, including external hashes and paths; it does not package or establish availability of external media.

ProcessingNativeObject.description: Native worker JSON, passed through without fabricating engine-specific schemas. Discover allowed/available engines and owner limits from capabilities; inspect job status and artifact manifests before using output.

name.description: Filename must use a supported suffix for its selected kind.

size.description: Declared bytes. Kind-specific, engine and owner limits can be lower; read capabilities.

engine.description: Choose an explicitly permitted engine marked available in capabilities; no fixed list is implied.

source_job.description: Optional completed job belonging to the same owner, only for an engine that permits source_job.

SourceUpload.description: A private transfer session. Only retained status has a project source ID usable by revisions/evidence. Sessions expire after 24 hours; verified ready state survives a late project-version conflict until expiry.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete original file, computed before creating or resuming the transfer.

CreateSourceUpload.description: Checks expected_version and reserves bounded object capacity without incrementing the project version. Default part size is 4 MiB; maximum 512 parts. Actual tenant limits can be lower.

uploads.description: Unexpired uploading, verifying, ready and failed sessions only. Retained sources are in the project aggregate.

download_path.description: Same-origin authenticated API path. Never a public or signed object-store URL.

data_base64.description: Exact bytes for inline sources; null for object sources. Stream object bytes from the authenticated content route.
